summary: RAG dimensional schema + LoRA adapter v2a_e1 cross
hypothesis: Grafting the ragDimensionalSchema in-context topology (exp015) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should combine the structured retrieval signal with the adapter's learned quality, pushing beyond either alone.
technique: A matrix-sweep cross of the exp015 RAG-dimensional-schema inference topology run on top of the best LoRA adapter (v2a_e1), evaluated greedily on the full-30 set — testing whether the best inference topology and best adapter are complementary.
result: Scored 0.304 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp015 baseline (0.243) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The combination did not unlock additive gains; discarded.
